ui.add.title: Become a contributor
ui.add.intro: Animundo is made by the families who play it. Every animal, plant and place is one small file, which you can make together with an AI assistant. No programming needed.
ui.add.step1: 1. Choose a real animal or plant, or a real place your family loves, like a forest, a lake or a national park.
ui.add.step2: 2. Open the community page. It has a prompt to copy into an AI assistant (like Claude), which writes the file with real facts.
ui.add.step3: 3. Try it in the game and fix anything that looks wrong.
ui.add.step4: 4. A local expert checks the facts. Then everyone can play it, with your nickname in the credits.
ui.add.note: Opening soon: we're still getting the contributor terms ready. Children under 16 take part through a parent, guardian or teacher.

ui.devices.intro: Your animals can live on a phone and a tablet at the same time. Get a code on one device. On the other device, open Your animals, tap Play on another device and type the code.
ui.devices.code_note: Type this code on the other device within {minutes} minutes. It works once.
ui.devices.code_failed: Couldn't get a code. Check the internet connection and try again.
ui.devices.enter_note: Type the code shown on your other device.
ui.devices.done: Done! Both devices now have the same animals.
ui.devices.bad_code: That code didn't work. A code works once, for {minutes} minutes. Check the internet connection too.
ui.story.title: Our story
ui.story.p1: I started talking with my son Daniel about what kind of game we could build for him. Daniel had just turned 7, and on our trips to school and back home we would talk about games.
ui.story.p2: Animundo: Animal Kingdom is one of the ideas we had. You play as real animals and do what real animals do. This way you learn about nature and animals.
